messages:
Sara: starting a soft shift to v2.14.0 on router-main. plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 6/15/60m. hold on p95 latency or >0.5% 5xx. @Alex you’re oncall for the 09:00-10:00 UTC window. :eyes:
Ben: release notes + changelog pinned to docs, deploy trigger ready. please ping when you hit start.
Deploy Bot: queued rollout v2.14.0 -> router-main. scheduled start in 2m. (canary region: eu-west-1)
Matt: smoke tests running against v2.14.0 image. small bump in KV cache misses (~3%), otherwise green.
Priya: dashboards prepped, adding temporary alert: 5xx > 1% sustained for 3m.
Deploy Bot: RAMP to 5% complete. traffic split applied. latency +2ms, errors 0.2%.
Alex: seeing a burst of OOMs from the v2.14.0 cohort in eu-west-1, tails spiking. telemetry -> heap growth on warmup. tagging as :rotating_light:.
Sara: ok quarantine: pin eu-west-1 back to v2.13 and halt global ramp. Ben, freeze rollout and enable rollback policy if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.
Ben: ack. pin command to run: `routerctl set-weight --route router-main --region eu-west-1 v2.14.0=0 v2.13.0=100`
Deploy Bot: traffic pin applied for eu-west-1. Global ramp paused. Canary cohort removed. Notifying rollout service.
Matt: collecting heap profiles now, will repro on an isolated pool and iterate on a hotfix branch.
Priya: opening a postmortem ticket, will hold release for 48h under tag "quarantine-eu-west-oom". adding SLO/alert owners.
Sara: flow for recovery: if hotfix passes unit+smoke, we do an isolated reinjection: v2.14.0 -> 10% in eu-west in a separate pool with stricter mem limits. need one SRE + oncall approval.
Alex: +1 from oncall to attempt isolated repro/reinject. ready to abort quickly. abort command: `deploy-bot abort-rollout 2929001234`
Deploy Bot: Manual hold engaged. Waiting on `deploy-bot resume-rollout --approve` with SRE signoff. Logs: https://internal.logs/release/2929001234
Ben: I've frozen traffic-change windows and updated release notes to include the quarantine and rollback steps. will follow up with a short post-deploy note once root cause is confirmed. :thumbsup:
